005package org.wpilib.smartdashboard;
006
007import java.util.HashMap;
008import java.util.Map;
009import java.util.Map.Entry;
010import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable;
011import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
012import org.wpilib.util.Color8Bit;
013
014/**
015 * Visual 2D representation of arms, elevators, and general mechanisms through a node-based API.
016 *
017 * <p>A Mechanism2d object is published and contains at least one root node. A root is the anchor
018 * point of other nodes (such as ligaments). Other nodes are recursively appended based on other
019 * nodes.
020 *
021 * @see MechanismObject2d
022 * @see MechanismLigament2d
023 * @see MechanismRoot2d
024 */
025public final class Mechanism2d implements TelemetryLoggable {
026  private final Map<String, MechanismRoot2d> m_roots;
027  private final double[] m_dims = new double[2];
028  private String m_color;
029
030  /**
031   * Create a new Mechanism2d with the given dimensions and default color (dark blue).
032   *
033   * <p>The dimensions represent the canvas that all the nodes are drawn on.
034   *
035   * @param width the width
036   * @param height the height
037   */
038  public Mechanism2d(double width, double height) {
039    this(width, height, new Color8Bit(0, 0, 32));
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Create a new Mechanism2d with the given dimensions.
044   *
045   * <p>The dimensions represent the canvas that all the nodes are drawn on.
046   *
047   * @param width the width
048   * @param height the height
049   * @param backgroundColor the background color. Defaults to dark blue.
050   */
051  public Mechanism2d(double width, double height, Color8Bit backgroundColor) {
052    m_roots = new HashMap<>();
053    m_dims[0] = width;
054    m_dims[1] = height;
055    setBackgroundColor(backgroundColor);
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Get or create a root in this Mechanism2d with the given name and position.
060   *
061   * <p>If a root with the given name already exists, the given x and y coordinates are not used.
062   *
063   * @param name the root name
064   * @param x the root x coordinate
065   * @param y the root y coordinate
066   * @return a new root joint object, or the existing one with the given name.
067   */
068  public synchronized MechanismRoot2d getRoot(String name, double x, double y) {
069    var existing = m_roots.get(name);
070    if (existing != null) {
071      return existing;
072    }
073
074    var root = new MechanismRoot2d(name, x, y);
075    m_roots.put(name, root);
076    return root;
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Set the Mechanism2d background color.
081   *
082   * @param color the new color
083   */
084  public synchronized void setBackgroundColor(Color8Bit color) {
085    m_color = color.toHexString();
086  }
087
088  @Override
089  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
090    synchronized (this) {
091      table.log("dims", m_dims);
092      table.log("backgroundColor", m_color);
093      for (Entry<String, MechanismRoot2d> entry : m_roots.entrySet()) {
094        table.log(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
095      }
096    }
097  }
098
099  @Override
100  public String getTelemetryType() {
101    return "Mechanism2d";
102  }
103}
